name: mern-enterprise-starter
description: Professional MERN Stack Starter with Client, Server, and Tailwind CSS v4

scripts.dev: concurrently -n "SERVER,CLIENT" -c "bgBlue.bold,bgMagenta.bold" "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix client install && npm --prefix server install
scripts.build: npm --prefix client install && npm --prefix client run build && npm --prefix server install
